rows.question: Where is the parking located?
rows.answer: Where is the parking? Demo Central Parking is located at 12 Example Avenue in the Demo District of Tbilisi. The address is fictional and used only for this demonstration.

rows.question: What is the maximum vehicle height?
rows.answer: The maximum vehicle height is 2.1 metres and the maximum length is 5.2 metres. Roof boxes and bicycle carriers count towards the height.

rows.question: Which metro station is closest to the garage?
rows.answer: The nearest metro station, Demo Square, is a five-minute walk from the garage. City buses stop at the Example Avenue stop next to the entrance.

rows.question: Can I charge my electric vehicle?
rows.answer: Two spaces are equipped with Type 2 electric vehicle chargers. Charging spaces are allocated on arrival and cannot be reserved in advance.

rows.question: How do I reserve a parking space?
rows.answer: You can reserve a space in this chat by saying that you want to book. The assistant asks for your first name, last name, car number, and the start and end of the reservation. You can give the details one by one or several at once, for example "car: AB123CD".

rows.question: Can I cancel a request I already submitted?
rows.answer: Changing or cancelling a request that was already submitted is not supported in the chat in this version. Before you confirm, you can edit any field of your draft or cancel it. For a submitted request, speak to the attendant.

rows.question: Can I choose a specific parking space?
rows.answer: No. All spaces are interchangeable, and the garage guarantees a free space for the reserved period rather than a particular bay.

rows.question: How can I pay for parking?
rows.answer: Parking is charged per hour. Every started hour is charged as a full hour, so a stay of 2 hours and 10 minutes is charged as 3 hours. The current hourly rate is part of the live facility data and is always taken from the database.

rows.question: What should I do if I lose my parking ticket?
rows.answer: If you lose your parking ticket, go to the entrance booth. The attendant will confirm your reservation using the car number.

rows.question: Is smoking allowed inside the garage?
rows.answer: The speed limit inside the garage is 5 km/h. Switch off the engine after parking. Smoking, refuelling and vehicle repairs are not allowed inside the garage.

rows.question: Can I park a truck or a caravan?
rows.answer: The garage is designed for passenger cars, small vans and SUVs. Motorcycles are welcome and use the same reservation process. Buses, trucks, trailers and caravans cannot be accommodated.

rows.question: Is the garage accessible for drivers with reduced mobility?
rows.answer: Spaces close to the lift are kept for drivers with reduced mobility. Tell the attendant on arrival. The lift connects all levels with the street.

rows.question: Who can see my reservation details?
rows.answer: Your reservation details are visible to you in your own chat session and to the parking administrator. The assistant never discloses details of other customers' reservations.

rows.question: Does a pending request guarantee me a space?
rows.answer: No. Only an approved reservation holds a space. Availability is checked again at the moment of approval.

rows.question: What date and time format should I use for booking?
rows.answer: Enter dates as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in local Tbilisi time, for example 2026-10-20 14:00. You can also write "tomorrow 09:00". The start must be in the future, the end must be after the start, and a reservation lasts between 30 minutes and 30 days.

rows.question: How early can I arrive before my reservation starts?
rows.answer: You may arrive up to 15 minutes before your reservation starts. The space is held for the whole reserved period. Please leave the garage by the end of your reservation.

rows.question: Is the garage protected by video surveillance?
rows.answer: The garage has 24-hour video surveillance, good lighting and an on-site attendant. Valuables should not be left visible in the car.

rows.question: What happens if my reservation request is rejected?
rows.answer: A rejected request does not hold a space and is not recorded. You can submit a new request for a different period.

rows.question: How much does parking cost per hour?
rows.answer: The current rate is GEL 5.00 per started hour; every started hour is charged as a full hour.

rows.question: What are your opening hours?
rows.answer: Opening hours: 24/7.

rows.question: Are there free spaces right now?
rows.answer: Right now 10 of 10 spaces are free for the next hour. Give me a period (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) to check a specific time.

rows.question: Are there free spaces from 2026-12-01 10:00 to 2026-12-01 12:00?
rows.answer: For 2026-12-01 10:00 (Asia/Tbilisi) - 2026-12-01 12:00 (Asia/Tbilisi) there are 10 of 10 spaces free (approved bookings only).

rows.question: Do you sell coffee at the entrance?
rows.answer: I don't have information about that in the parking documents. I can help with location, rules, services, prices, opening hours, availability and reservations.

rows.question: What is the weather forecast in Paris?
